_note: The African bullfrog's life (the animal life kit; breeding on 2026-11-21, docs/plans/prey-fish-and-frogs.md step 4; every number my pick, fun first, inspired by the real frog). Sizes are shares of a male's usual 0.8 blocks: males 0.9 to 1.1 of it, females 0.65 blocks (the user's) 0.9 to 1.1, so 0.73 to 0.89. Its young are tadpoles, an animal of their own (animal_life/tadpole.json): a tadpole turns into a froglet here, a teen 0.25 blocks long (0.31 of a male) that is grown in 3 days. They breed in the rains while it rains, every 4 days: ready males go into the shallow water and call, wrestle a rival male that comes close (the smaller gives way), and a ready female comes to a calling male; he clasps her from behind 10 seconds (courtship ticks count every other game tick) and she lays a film of 8 to 12 eggs on the water there; the father guards the spot 5 days (the eggs' day and the tadpoles' 4). Breeds only while fewer than 12 bullfrogs live within 48 blocks and the bullfrog group (cap 4 round a player) has room.
